title: Nico the Little Reindeer’s Snowy Day
subtitle: A Bold & Easy Color & Read Story Book for Kids Ages 3-6

pages.text: Nico the reindeer wakes up. Look, it snowed!
pages.scene: sitting up in his cozy bed with a patchwork blanket, looking amazed out a window at big falling snowflakes

pages.text: Nico wraps his warm, red scarf around his neck.
pages.scene: standing in his bedroom happily wrapping a big fluffy red scarf around his neck

pages.text: Mama makes hot cocoa with marshmallows.
pages.scene: at a kitchen table with Mama Reindeer (a bigger reindeer wearing an apron) who is pouring hot cocoa into two mugs with marshmallows

pages.text: Nico pulls on his fuzzy snow boots.
pages.scene: sitting on a little bench by the front door pulling on a big fuzzy boot, other boot beside him

pages.text: Whoosh! The door opens to a snowy world.
pages.scene: standing at an open front door with wide eyes, looking out at a snowy yard with pine trees and falling snowflakes

pages.text: Nico makes his very first snow angel.
pages.scene: lying on his back in deep snow making a snow angel, arms and legs spread wide, laughing

pages.text: Nico meets Tilly the penguin.
pages.scene: waving hello to Tilly, a cute little penguin (round body, small wings, tiny beak, wearing a knitted hat), in a snowy yard

pages.text: Tilly has a bright red sled.
pages.scene: and Tilly the penguin standing next to a simple wooden sled with a rope, at the top of a small snowy hill

pages.text: Whee! They zoom down the big hill.
pages.scene: and Tilly the penguin riding together on a sled zooming down a snowy hill, snow spraying behind them

pages.text: Bump! They tumble into the soft snow.
pages.scene: and Tilly the penguin tumbling off the sled into a big fluffy snowdrift, snow puffs flying, both laughing

pages.text: They roll a big, round snowball.
pages.scene: and Tilly the penguin pushing a large snowball together across the snow, a trail behind it

pages.text: Now they build a snowman together.
pages.scene: and Tilly the penguin stacking snowballs to build a round snowman with no face yet

pages.text: The snowman needs a nose. A carrot!
pages.scene: holding up a big carrot and Tilly the penguin pointing at the snowman's face where the nose goes

pages.text: Tilly adds two shiny button eyes.
pages.scene: and Tilly the penguin, standing on a little stool, putting two big round buttons on the snowman as eyes

pages.text: Nico gives the snowman his red scarf.
pages.scene: gently wrapping his scarf around the finished smiling snowman, Tilly the penguin clapping

pages.text: Snowflakes twinkle in the sky.
pages.scene: and Tilly the penguin looking up at big twinkling snowflakes and a few stars, snowy pine trees around

pages.text: Nico catches a snowflake on his tongue.
pages.scene: with tongue stuck out catching a big snowflake, eyes closed, big smile, Tilly the penguin giggling

pages.text: Look! A little deer peeks from the trees.
pages.scene: and Tilly the penguin pointing at a shy little fawn named Willow peeking out from behind a snowy pine tree

pages.text: Nico shares his juicy apple with Willow.
pages.scene: holding out a big red apple to Willow the fawn, Tilly the penguin looking hungry and happy

pages.text: They slide across the frozen pond.
pages.scene: and Tilly the penguin sliding on a frozen pond, Willow the fawn watching from the edge, reeds and snow

pages.text: Slip, slide! Nico spins round and round.
pages.scene: spinning on the ice with arms out, dizzy and laughing, snow swirl lines around him

pages.text: They build a cozy snow fort.
pages.scene: and Tilly the penguin and Willow the fawn stacking snow blocks into a small fort with a tiny flag on top

pages.text: They hang seeds for hungry birds.
pages.scene: and Tilly the penguin and Willow the fawn hanging a pine cone covered in seeds from a snowy branch, three small round birds gathering to eat

pages.text: Ready, aim, splat! Right in the middle!
pages.scene: throwing a soft snowball at a round target drawn on a tree stump, Tilly the penguin cheering

pages.text: Brrr! Nico’s little hooves feel cold.
pages.scene: shivering with hunched shoulders, hugging himself, a small snow cloud puff from his breath, Tilly the penguin wrapping a blanket around him

pages.text: Mama waves from the cozy front door.
pages.scene: running toward home while Mama Reindeer waves from a warm glowing doorway of a little cottage, smoke curling from the chimney

pages.text: Nico and Mama sip cocoa by the fire.
pages.scene: and Mama Reindeer sitting on a soft rug by a crackling fireplace, holding mugs of cocoa

pages.text: Mama tucks Nico into his warm bed.
pages.scene: tucked into bed by Mama Reindeer who is pulling the blanket up to his chin, a teddy bear on the pillow

pages.text: Goodnight, Nico. Sweet dreams!
pages.scene: fast asleep in bed hugging a teddy bear, eyes closed, window showing a smiling crescent moon and big stars over snowy trees

special.title: Nico the little reindeer and Tilly the penguin playing happily in a snowy meadow with a snowman, snowy hills and pine trees; keep the top third of the picture open sky with only a few simple clouds and snowflakes
special.belongs: Nico the little reindeer sitting up in his cozy bed waving, patchwork blanket, bed footboard in front; keep the bottom third of the picture calm (just the blanket and bed) with nothing small or busy

cover.blurb:
Color and read along with Nico!

It’s a snowy morning, and Nico the little reindeer can’t wait to play outside. He makes a snow angel, meets his new friend Tilly the penguin, zooms down a hill on a sled, builds a snowman, and cozies up with Mama for cocoa by the fire.

Every page has one short sentence in BIG, easy letters and one big, bold picture that’s just right for little hands.

• Adorable full-page coloring pictures that tell one sweet story
• Bold, thick lines that are easy to color
• Big letters for early readers
• A “This book belongs to” page
• Perfect for ages 3-6
